issues.title: Bangladesh, Maldives discuss stronger security cooperation, regional stability
issues.title_en: Bangladesh, Maldives discuss stronger security cooperation, regional stability
issues.summary: The two countries exchanged views on maritime security, counterterrorism and transnational crime ahead of the upcoming Colombo Security Conclave meeting in Malé.
